about: Surveyed road surfaces for the Port Lands streets the City's Edge of Roadway layer does not have (it predates their rebuilding, newest geometry 2024-11-26), and the City polygons the 2025 orthophoto shows are no longer road. Read by tools/geo-blocks.mjs (surfaces drawn as roadway where their kind is a carriageway, transit way or bridge deck; retired City polygons dropped) and tools/geo-roads.mjs (bridge deck widths). Written by tools/build-road-surfaces.mjs from the stations below. See docs/road-widths.md.
datum: lon/lat in the City of Toronto's frame: NAD83(CSRS) coordinates labelled WGS84, the frame of the City's Edge of Roadway layer and of its 2025 orthophoto (about 1 m from true WGS84 here). The offsets were measured from the OSM centre lines placed with no datum shift, as the City frame and the game place them.
method: At each station a 30 x 8 m strip of the City's 2025 orthophoto was resampled at 0.05 m across and along the OSM centre line (way id, metres from its first node) and the kerb lines read from the image and from the per-column median brightness (asphalt ~200-230, kerb and concrete ~245-255, planting ~130-170). left/right are the kerb offsets in metres from the centre line, negative to the left of the way's direction; width = right - left; the reading is good to about +-0.25 m per edge where both kerbs are clear. Surfaces are ribbons along the OSM centre lines with the offsets interpolated linearly between stations along each chain and held at the chain's ends.

ground.reason: City polygon 56694 (Road Edge, maintained 2023-01-16) is right for the merged Commissioners carriageway east of the split, but its western tail is old Commissioners Street: south of the eastbound lane's kerb (+3.1 to +3.4 m from the OSM centre line at 80, 95, 104, 108 and 111 m) the 2025 orthophoto shows grass, a power pylon, then the cycle track and sidewalk. That strip, from the kerb 16 m out, from 74 m along the way to its end at the merge, is ground; east of the merge the polygon's south edge is the real kerb and it is kept.

The last corner of City polygon 56694's old Commissioners tail, where the eastbound lane merges: along the merge link (way 1418441607, not a surveyed carriageway) the 2025 orthophoto shows the kerb at +3.3 m (2 m along) and +3.5 m (8 m), then grass, the cycle track (+6.75 to +9 m), grass and the sidewalk (+10.75 to +12.5 m). That strip, from the kerb 9 m out, between 0 and 9 m along the link, is ground; at 11 m the link is in the next junction's asphalt.
